class.name: ContextProxy
class.brief_description: Async record placed in the ActivityManager stack/queues while the real node is still loading.
class.description:
ContextProxy is the lightweight, ref-counted record [ActivityManager] holds in its stack, dialogs and toast queue. It is created synchronously at the call site of [method Context.start_activity], [method Context.show_dialog] or [method Context.show_toast] so flag matching (SINGLE_TOP/CLEAR_TOP/...) and stack-size queries remain consistent even while the underlying scene is still being loaded on a background thread.
Concrete subclasses are [ActivityProxy], [DialogProxy] and [ToastProxy]. Listen to [signal ready] to obtain the underlying [Node] once it is attached, or [signal cancelled]/[signal failed] for the unhappy paths.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Request cancellation. Only meaningful while the proxy is [constant STATE_PENDING] or [constant STATE_LOADING]; terminal states ignore.

method.name: get_application
method.description: Returns the [Application] that owns this proxy.

method.name: get_instance_node
method.description: Returns the attached [Node] (Activity/Dialog/Toast) if it is alive, or [code]null[/code] while still loading or after destruction.

method.name: get_intent
method.description: Returns the [Intent] that produced this proxy.

method.name: get_scene_path
method.description: Returns the scene path that was resolved from the Intent's action.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the current lifecycle state. See the [enum State] constants.

method.name: is_terminal
method.description: True if the proxy is in [constant STATE_FAILED], [constant STATE_CANCELLED] or [constant STATE_FINISHED].

signal.name: cancelled
signal.description: Emitted when the proxy was cancelled before reaching [constant STATE_READY].

signal.name: failed
signal.description: Emitted when the scene could not be loaded or instantiated. [param reason] is a human-readable description.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when a previously [constant STATE_READY] node has been destroyed via the normal lifecycle.

signal.name: ready
signal.description: Emitted when the underlying [Node] has been instantiated, parented and dispatched its create lifecycle.

constants.constant: Created but the load has not started yet (e.g. a queued Toast).
The scene is being loaded asynchronously.
The node has been instantiated, parented and dispatched its create lifecycle.
The proxy was cancelled before reaching READY.
The previously-READY node was destroyed via the normal lifecycle.
